installers.description: Opt-in portable Lanes CLI and native global Codex/Claude skill copies; no hooks, settings or credentials.

optional.name: node
optional.description: Node.js >=22 runs the lanes command and its installer. Without node, run them with uvx --from 'nodejs-wheel==24.*' node. The installer checks the version itself.

npx.install: npx skills add rahuldave/sklanes -g -a codex -a claude-code --skill lanes --copy -y
